PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

5 -> 0: every service mail registers now returns an instance from start(), not an
object literal.

  removed  discuss.ptt_extension   discuss/call/common/ptt_extension_service.js  100
  removed  im_status               core/common/im_status_service.js               65
  removed  discuss.pip_service     discuss/call/common/pip_service.js             57
  removed  mail.fullscreen         core/common/mail_fullscreen.js                 56
  removed  mail.composer           core/common/composer_service.js                33
  added    none

23 of 23 services are now instance- or unknown-shaped; the literal partition is
empty.

WHAT THE LITERAL SHAPE WAS COSTING IS NOT STYLE. Each of these five kept its real
state in `start()`'s closure -- lastSentInactivity and becomeAwayTimeout in
im_status, pipWindow in the pip service, id and closeOverlay in fullscreen -- and
exported a hand-picked slice of it. Closure state is invisible to every static
gate, unreachable from a test, and un-overridable by a downstream addon; the same
state on an instance is all three. im_status is the clearest case: it returned
`{ updateBusPresence }` and nothing else, so its away-timeout bookkeeping could
not be observed at all.

The shape copied is the one already in this module -- mail_core_common_service
and mail_core_web_service both do `reactive(new X(env, services))` in start()
followed by `x.setup()`, with the constructor taking collaborators and setup()
doing the subscriptions. `reactive` and `markRaw` are transparent wrappers to
this gate, so the reactive services keep their reactivity and still read as
instances. im_status was not reactive before and is not reactive now.

TWO PLACES NEEDED markRaw AND ARE THE ONLY BEHAVIOURAL RISK IN THE CHANGE.
Wrapping an instance in reactive() proxies whatever it holds, and two of the
things these services hold must not be proxied: the ptt service's version
promise, because awaiting a proxied promise calls then() on an incompatible
receiver, and the pip service's Window handle, because the code goes on to touch
pipWindow.document.body.style through it. Both were closure variables before --
outside the reactive object by construction -- so markRaw restores exactly the
old semantics rather than introducing a new one. env and the injected services
are left proxied, matching mail_core_common_service.

Two small de-duplications came out of it: composer's setHtmlComposer and
setTextComposer were the same three lines under opposite polarity and now share
_setHtmlEnabled(bool); ptt's 45-line message switch became onPushToTalkPressed
and onToggleVoice beside the dispatcher, which is also the whole of the
jsfunclen_mail move in this change.

Verification: the entire mail JS suite, all 144 files, 1477 tests, 0 failed --
run as the 18 discuss/call suites (112) plus four groups covering the remaining
125 (370 + 576 + 246 + 173). npx eslint and npx prettier --check clean on all
